subject.title: feat: unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should OpenClaw ship the public session-catalog plugin API and make the Codex operator catalog active whenever the plugin is active, independent of supervision.enabled?
rationale: This permanently expands the external plugin contract and changes the meaning of an existing explicit setting; implementation correctness alone cannot decide that product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Ship unified catalogs
options.body: Approve the generic SDK/gateway contract and zero-config operator catalog while keeping agent-facing supervision tools opt-in.

options.title: Preserve catalog opt-in
options.body: Approve the generic contract but continue using supervision.enabled to control operator catalog visibility.

options.title: Defer public API
options.body: Keep the existing provider-specific catalog behavior until maintainers are ready to stabilize an external catalog contract.

recommendation.title: Ship unified catalogs
recommendation.body: Approve the generic SDK/gateway contract and zero-config operator catalog while keeping agent-facing supervision tools opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked product issue and recent catalog feature history are primarily carried by steipete.
